Settings.Name: First-person combat
Settings.Description: Stay in first person when combat starts. Off returns to the normal tactical camera.

Settings.Name: Body style
Settings.Description: Full size: a classic first-person experience with optional floating weapons, normal torch light, and lingering buff glows on you hidden. Shrunken: a cleaner first-person view with less clutter in combat: small spell effects and a tiny move/jump preview. A held torch gives only a small light.
Settings.Tooltip: Applies the next time you zoom into first person.

Settings.Name: Show held items
Settings.Description: Show drawn weapons, shields and a held torch in first person.
